ns2:course.label: Jazz Improvisation Styles II
ns2:course.description: A continuation of the survey of improvisational/jazz artists at an advanced level. Students write and present four papers and associated recording transcriptions of four advanced improvisational/jazz artists representing four distinct and advanced improvisational/jazz styles. All presentations will be done in class. Prerequisite: MUS 368 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MUS 368 or consent of instructor.
